heading: Second mortgage assistance for first-time homebuyers

tree.heading: In general
tree.text: The Secretary shall make available a model program under which units of general local government provide loans (secured by second mortgages) with deferred payment of interest and principal to first-time homebuyers.

tree.heading: Homeownership counseling
tree.text: The program under this section shall provide for homeownership counseling to first-time homebuyers assisted, which shall include—

children.text: counseling before and after purchase of the property;
assisting first-time homebuyers in identifying the most suitable and affordable properties;
providing homebuyers with financial management assistance;
assisting homebuyers in understanding mortgage transactions and home sales contracts; and
assisting homebuyers with eliminating any credit problems that may prevent the homebuyers from purchasing the property.

tree.heading: Eligibility requirements
tree.text: Deferred payment loans secured by second mortgages may be provided under the model program under this section if—

children.text: the homebuyer assisted is a first-time homebuyer;
the property secured by the second mortgage is a single-family residence and is the principal residence of the homebuyer; and
the principal obligation of the deferred payment loan secured by a second mortgage does not exceed 30 percent of the acquisition price of the residence to the homebuyer.

children.heading: Period of deferral
children.text: The payment of any principal and interest on a loan under this section shall be deferred for not less than the 5-year period beginning on the date of the acquisition of the residence by the homebuyer.

children.heading: Interest rate
children.text: The interest rate on the unpaid balance of a loan under this section shall be at least 4 percent.

children.heading: Repayment period
children.text: A deferred payment loan secured by a second mortgage shall be repayable over the 15-year period beginning at the end of the deferral period.

tree.heading: Security
tree.text: A deferred payment loan assisted with amount 1 provided under a grant under this section shall be secured by a lien on the property involved, which lien shall be subordinate to the first mortgage on the property.
